_comment: Edit Traditional Chinese (zhHant) and English (en) here. Use {count}, {n}, {total}, {earned}, {paws}, {seconds}, {answer} where shown.

welcomeLede.zhHant: 和狗狗 Pip、貓咪 Miso 一起檢查回收食物——真正餵寵物前，一定要先問大人。
welcomeLede.en: Help Pip the dog and Miso the cat inspect rescued food — then always ask a grown-up before feeding a real pet.

instruction1.zhHant: 看看食物照片、名稱和製作說明。
instruction1.en: Look at the food photo, name and preparation details.

instruction2.en: Tap optional clues if you want a hint.

instruction3.zhHant: 選擇可能適合誰：狗、貓、兩者都可以、兩者都不行，或先問大人。
instruction3.en: Choose who it might be for: Dog, Cat, Both, Neither, or Ask a grown-up.

instruction4.zhHant: 完成 {count} 種食物各得一隻爪印。第一次答錯還可以再試一次。
instruction4.en: Earn one paw for each of {count} foods you finish. You can try again if your first guess needs another look.

reminderAskGrownUp.zhHant: 提醒：真正餵寵物前，一定要先問大人。
reminderAskGrownUp.en: Reminder: always ask a grown-up before offering food to a real pet.

reminderCompact.zhHant: 真正餵寵物前，一定要先問大人。
reminderCompact.en: Always ask a grown-up before feeding a real pet.

attemptNote.zhHant: 再仔細看看——你還有一次機會。
attemptNote.en: Take another careful look — you have one more try.

answerGroupAria.en: Who could this food be for?

feedbackRetryBody.zhHant: 這個選擇和食物細節不太吻合。再看看製作方式和提示，然後再試一次。
feedbackRetryBody.en: That choice does not match this food’s details. Check the preparation and clues, then try once more.

completionLede.zhHant: 你檢查了 {total} 種食物，收集了 {paws} 隻爪印。記住：真正餵寵物前要先問大人。
completionLede.en: You inspected {total} foods and collected {paws} progress paws. Remember: ask a grown-up before feeding a real pet.

inactivityDesc.zhHant: 遊戲將在 {seconds} 秒後重新開始，方便下一位訪客遊玩。
inactivityDesc.en: This game will restart in {seconds} seconds so the next visitor can play.

adultToggle.zhHant: 給大人：安全與資料來源

safety1.zhHant: 這是給 6–9 歲的教育檢查遊戲，不是獸醫建議。
safety1.en: This is an educational inspection game for ages 6–9, not veterinary advice.

safety2.zhHant: 真正把食物給寵物前，一定要先問大人。
safety2.en: Always ask a grown-up before offering any food to a real pet.

safety3.zhHant: 精選的消費前剩餘食物（尚未使用、仍安全的食物）和盤中剩菜或腐壞食物不同。
safety3.en: Selected pre-consumer surplus (unused, still-safe food) is different from plate scraps or spoiled food.

safety4.zhHant: 初期卡片標示為草稿，有待合格審核。請勿從本遊戲推導餵食份量或均衡餐食食譜。
safety4.en: Initial cards are marked draft pending qualified review. Do not invent feeding quantities or balanced-meal recipes from this game.

sourcesHint.zhHant: 遊戲中只以文字顯示網址。請在遊戲結束後用其他裝置開啟。
sourcesHint.en: URLs are listed as text only during play. Open them on a separate device after the session.

assetPreviewLede.zhHant: 缺少的檔案會顯示標籤佔位圖，不會出現破圖圖示。請把檔案放到 public/assets/ 並使用相同路徑。
assetPreviewLede.en: Missing files show labelled placeholders instead of broken-image icons. Replace files under public/assets/ using the same paths.
